info.name: V5.0
info.description:
# Bold Reports REST API v5.0 Overview

This Postman collection provides a comprehensive set of API endpoints for interacting with the Bold Reports Enterprise Edition v5.0, designed to facilitate robust integration and management of reporting functionalities within your server environment. The collection aligns with the official Bold Reports [REST API v5.0](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#section/Introduction) documentation, enabling developers to authenticate, manage users, groups, items, permissions, settings, attributes, and audit logs efficiently.

## Key Features

- **Authentication**: Securely obtain a Bearer token using username and password credentials to authenticate API requests.
    
- **User Management**: Add, retrieve, update, delete, and activate/deactivate users, with support for bulk user imports via CSV and automatic addition to default groups.
    
- **Group Management**: Create, retrieve, update, delete, and manage user memberships within groups for streamlined access control.
    
- **Item Management**: Manage reports, datasets, data sources, categories, and schedules, including operations like moving, copying, exporting, and checking item name existence.
    
- **Permission Management**: Assign and manage multiple permissions for users and groups on specific items, ensuring granular access control.
    
- **Settings Configuration**: Update account settings, email settings, branding, and IP whitelisting, and generate embed secret keys.
    
- **Attribute Management**: Add, update, retrieve, and delete site, user, and group attributes with encryption support.
    
- **Audit Logs**: Retrieve detailed activity logs for users, groups, permissions, comments, schedules, system settings, and items.
    

## Collection Structure

The collection is organized into the following key sections, each corresponding to critical API functionalities:

1. **Password Authentication**:
    
    - **Authenticate User**: POST request to retrieve a Bearer token using the `/token` endpoint.
        
2. **Items**:
    
    - **Get Specific Item Detail**: GET request to retrieve details of a specific item by ID.
        
    - **Move Report**: POST request to move a report to a specified folder.
        
    - **Get Version History**: GET request to retrieve the version history of a specific item.
        
    - **Add Category**: POST request to create a new category.
        
    - **Update Category**: PUT request to update a category.
        
    - **Check Item Name Exists**: POST request to verify if an item name exists in a category.
        
    - **Add Datasource**: POST request to create a new data source with detailed configuration.
        
    - **Update Datasource**: PUT request to update a specific data source.
        
    - **Add Dataset**: POST request to create a new dataset.
        
    - **Update Dataset**: PUT request to update a specific dataset.
        
    - **Update Report**: PUT request to update a specific report with detailed mapping.
        
    - **Download Items**: POST request to download multiple items by ID.
        
    - **Get Schedule Items**: GET request to retrieve a list of scheduled items.
        
    - **Get All Tags**: GET request to retrieve all tags used in items.
        
    - **Get Items**: GET request to retrieve a list of items filtered by `itemType`.
        
    - **Delete Item**: DELETE request to remove a specific item using `itemType` and `serverPath`.
        
    - **Add Schedule**: POST request to create a schedule with recurrence and S3 export options.
        
    - **Get Specific Schedule Detail**: GET request to fetch details of a specific schedule by ID or name.
        
    - **Update Schedule**: PUT request to update a schedule's details.
        
    - **Run Specific Schedule**: GET request to immediately execute a specific schedule.
        
    - **Get Item Location**: GET request to retrieve the location of a report, data source, or dataset.
        
    - **Export Report**: POST request to export a report to a specified format (e.g., PDF) with optional filters.
        
    - **Copy Report**: POST request to copy a report to a specified folder with dataset and sub-report mapping.
        
3. **Users**:
    
    - **Add User(s) to Default Group**: POST request to create users and add them to the default group.
        
    - **Get List of Users**: GET request to retrieve all users.
        
    - **Activate or Deactivate User**: POST request to toggle user activation status.
        
    - **Get Specific User Detail by Email or Username**: GET request to retrieve user details by email or username.
        
    - **Edit User**: PUT request to update user details.
        
    - **Delete User**: DELETE request to remove a specific user.
        
    - **Add CSV User**: POST request to upload users via CSV content.
        
4. **Groups**:
    
    - **Add Group**: POST request to create a new group.
        
    - **Get List of Groups**: GET request to retrieve all groups.
        
    - **Get Specific Group Detail**: GET request to fetch details of a specific group by ID.
        
    - **Edit Group**: PUT request to update group details.
        
    - **Delete Group**: DELETE request to remove a group.
        
    - **Get List of Users from Group**: GET request to retrieve users in a specific group.
        
    - **Delete User(s) from Group**: DELETE request to remove users from a group.
        
    - **Add User(s) to Group**: POST request to add users to a specific group.
        
5. **Settings**:
    
    - **Update Account Settings**: PUT request to configure account settings like activation mode and default group.
        
    - **Get IP Whitelisting Settings**: GET request to retrieve IP whitelisting settings.
        
    - **Update IP Whitelisting Settings**: POST request to update IP whitelisting rules.
        
    - **Generate Embed Secret Key**: POST request to generate an embed secret key.
        
    - **Update Branding**: PUT request to update branding settings.
        
    - **Update Email Settings**: PUT request to configure email settings.
        
6. **Attributes**:
    
    - **Add Site Attribute**: POST request to add a site attribute with encryption option.
        
    - **Get Site Attributes**: GET request to retrieve all site attributes.
        
    - **Update Site Attribute**: PUT request to update a site attribute.
        
    - **Delete Site Attributes**: DELETE request to remove a site attribute by ID.
        
    - **Add User Attribute**: POST request to add an attribute to a user.
        
    - **Update User Attribute**: PUT request to update a user attribute.
        
    - **Get User Attribute**: GET request to retrieve attributes for a specific user.
        
    - **Delete User Attribute**: DELETE request to remove user attributes.
        
    - **Add Group Attribute**: POST request to add an attribute to a group.
        
    - **Update Group Attribute**: PUT request to update a group attribute.
        
    - **Get Group Attribute**: GET request to retrieve attributes for a specific group.
        
    - **Delete Group Attribute**: DELETE request to remove group attributes.
        
7. **Permission**:
    
    - **Add Multiple User Permissions**: POST request to assign multiple permissions to users for specific items.
        
    - **Add Multiple Group Permissions**: POST request to assign multiple permissions to groups for specific items.
        
    - **Get List of User Permissions**: GET request to retrieve permissions for a specific user.
        
    - **Delete User Permission**: DELETE request to remove a user’s permission for an item.
        
    - **Get List of Group Permissions**: GET request to retrieve permissions for a specific group.
        
    - **Delete Group Permission**: DELETE request to remove a group’s permission for an item.
        
8. **Audit Logs**:
    
    - **All Activity Logs**: GET request to retrieve all activity logs with optional filters.
        
    - **Group Activity Logs**: GET request to fetch group-related activity logs.
        
    - **Group Permission Activity Logs**: GET request for group permission logs.
        
    - **User Activity Logs**: GET request for user-related activity logs.
        
    - **User Permission Activity Logs**: GET request for user permission logs.
        
    - **Comment Activity Logs**: GET request for comment-related logs.
        
    - **Schedule Activity Logs**: GET request for schedule-related logs.
        
    - **System Settings Activity Logs**: GET request for system settings logs.
        
    - **Item Activity Logs**: GET request for item-related activity logs.
        

## Getting Started

To use this collection:

1. **Set Up Environment Variables**: Configure `base_url`, `tenant_name`, `username`, `password`, `access_token`, `id`, `itemType`, `serverPath`, `scheduleId`, `user_mail`, `groupID`, `groupName`, `userID`, `SiteAttributeID`, and `activitymodule`, `activity`, `itemtype` in your Postman environment for seamless API calls.
    
2. **Authenticate**: Start with the "Authenticate User" request to obtain a Bearer token, required for all subsequent requests.
    
3. **Explore Endpoints**: Use the structured requests to manage users, groups, items, permissions, settings, attributes, or audit logs as needed.
    
4. **Refer to Documentation**: For detailed endpoint specifications, consult the official Bold Reports REST API v5.0 documentation at [Bold Reports Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#section/Introduction).
    

## Notes

- Ensure the `access_token` is updated regularly, as tokens may expire based on server configurations.
    
- The API endpoints follow the structure `{{base_url}}/reporting/api/site/{{tenant_name}}/v5.0/{endpoint}`, as outlined in the Bold Reports documentation.
    
- For testing, you can use the public demo server credentials provided in the Bold Reports documentation to generate an access token.
    
- The v5.0 API introduces advanced attribute management for sites, users, and groups, with encryption support, and enhanced schedule management with S3 export capabilities.
    
- The `serverPath` parameter for reports requires a format like `/{category name}/{report name}`, while other item types use the item name.
    

This collection simplifies interaction with the Bold Reports v5.0 REST API, enabling developers to efficiently manage reporting resources. For further assistance, refer to the linked documentation or contact the Bold Reports support team.

item.name: Password Authentication

request.description:
This endpoint allows you to obtain a Bearer token for authentication by providing a username and password. The token is required for all subsequent API requests in the Bold Reports v5.0 REST API. This endpoint is part of the Password Authentication flow and is essential for securing access to other API operations.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Authenticate User Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/PasswordAuthentication).

item.description: The "Password Authentication" in the Bold Reports v5.0 Postman collection contains a single endpoint designed to facilitate secure authentication for accessing the Bold Reports Enterprise Edition API. This folder is critical for initiating API interactions, as it provides the mechanism to obtain a Bearer token required for all authenticated requests in the v5.0 API.

item.name: Items

request.description:
This endpoint retrieves detailed information about a specific item (e.g., report, dataset) identified by its ID.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Get Specific Item Detail Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Items_GetItemDetail).

This endpoint moves a report to a specified folder using the report’s ID and target category ID.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Move Report Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Items_MoveReport).

This endpoint retrieves the version history of a specific item identified by its ID.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Get Version History Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Items_VersionHistory).

This endpoint creates a new category for organizing reports and other items.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Add Category Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Items_AddCategory).

This endpoint updates the details of an existing category.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Update Category Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Items_UpdateCategory).

This endpoint verifies if an item name already exists within a specified category.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Check Item Name Exists Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Items_IsItemNameExists).

This endpoint creates a new data source with detailed configuration, including connection strings and authentication.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Add Datasource Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Items_AddDataSource).

This endpoint updates an existing data source with specified details.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Update Datasource Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Items_UpdateDataSource).

This endpoint creates a new dataset with specified details and data source mappings.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Add Dataset Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Items_AddDataSet).

This endpoint updates an existing dataset with specified details.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Update Dataset Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Items_UpdateDataSet).

This endpoint updates an existing report with specified details, including data source and dataset mappings.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Update Report Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Items_UpdateReport).

This endpoint downloads multiple items (e.g., reports, datasets) by their IDs.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Download Items Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Items_DownloadReport).

This endpoint retrieves a list of all scheduled items in the system.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Get Schedule Items Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Items_GetScheduleItems).

This endpoint retrieves all tags used across items in the Bold Reports system.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Get All Tags Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Report_Tags).

query.description: Values allowed are Category, Report, Datasource, Dataset, and Schedule
Category path

Provide the report tag name(s).
Note: If there are multiple tag names, they should be passed as comma-separated values i.e tags=tag1,tag2,tag3
It is possible to obtain report details without using the tag query parameter.

request.description:
This endpoint retrieves a list of items filtered by the specified itemType.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Get Items Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Items_GetItems).

query.description: Valid values are Category, Report, Datasource, Dataset, Schedule

To delete the report provide your report path like /{category name}/{report name}.
And to delete the Category, Datasource, Dataset, Schedule simply provide the name of the item.

request.description:
This endpoint deletes a specific item using the itemType and serverPath query parameters.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Delete Item Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Items_DeleteItemV3).

This endpoint creates a new schedule for an item with recurrence and S3 export options.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Add Schedule Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Items_AddSchedule).

query.description: Schedule ID or Schedule Name

request.description:

This endpoint updates the details of an existing schedule for an item.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Update Schedule Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Items_UpdateSchedule).

query.description: Valid values are Report, Datasource, Dataset

To get the reports location provide your report path like /{category name}/{report name}.
And to get the Datasource and Dataset location simply provide the name of the item.

request.description:
This endpoint retrieves the location of a specific item (e.g., Report, Datasource, Dataset) using itemType and serverPath.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Get Item Location Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Items_GetItemLocationV3).

This endpoint exports a report to a specified format (e.g., PDF) with optional filters.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Export Report Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Items_ExportReportV3).

query.description: Provide the report path like /{category name}/{report name}

request.description:
This endpoint copies a report to a specified folder with options for data source and dataset inclusion.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Copy Report Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Items_CopyReport).

item.description: The "Items" in the Bold Reports v5.0 Postman collection contains fourteen endpoints focused on managing reporting items such as reports, datasets, data sources, categories, and schedules within the Bold Reports Enterprise Edition. These endpoints enable developers to create, retrieve, update, delete, move, export, and schedule items, as well as manage version history and tags, providing comprehensive control over reporting resources.

item.name: Users

request.description:
This endpoint creates one or more users and automatically adds them to the default group in the Bold Reports system.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Add User(s) to Default Group Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Groups_AddUserToDefaultGroup).

This endpoint retrieves a list of all users registered in the Bold Reports system.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Get List of Users Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Users_GetUsers).

This endpoint toggles the activation status of a specific user identified by their email or username.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Activate or Deactivate User Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Users_ActivateDeactivateuser).

item.name: Get Specific User Detail by Email or Username

request.description:
This endpoint retrieves detailed information about a specific user identified by their email or username.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Get Specific User Detail by Email or Username Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Users_GetUserDetail).

This endpoint updates the details of an existing user identified by their email or username.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Edit User Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Users_EditUser).

This endpoint deletes a specific user account identified by their email or username.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Delete User Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Users_DeleteUser).

This endpoint imports multiple users into the Bold Reports system via CSV content.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Add CSV User Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Users_CsvUserImport).

This endpoint downloads a CSV template for bulk user imports, providing a standardized format for user data.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Download CSV Template Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Users_DownloadCsvTemplate).

item.name: Get Group Details Of Particular User

request.description:
This endpoint retrieves group membership details for a specific user identified by their email or username.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Get Group Details Of Particular User Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Users_GetGroupsOfUser).

item.description: The "Users" in the Bold Reports v5.0 Postman collection contains seven endpoints focused on managing user accounts within the Bold Reports Enterprise Edition. These endpoints enable developers to create, retrieve, update, delete, and manage user activation, as well as support bulk user imports via CSV and automatic addition to default groups, streamlining user administration.

item.name: Groups

request.description:
This endpoint creates a new group in the Bold Reports system with a specified name and description.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Add Group Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Groups_AddGroup).

This endpoint retrieves a list of all groups in the Bold Reports system.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Get List of Groups Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Groups_GetGroupsV2).

This endpoint retrieves detailed information about a specific group identified by its ID.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Get Specific Group Detail Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Groups_GetGroupDetail).

This endpoint updates the details of an existing group identified by its ID.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Edit Group Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Groups_EditGroup).

This endpoint deletes a specific group identified by its ID.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Delete Group Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Groups_DeleteGroup).

item.name: Get List Of Users From Group

request.description:
This endpoint retrieves a list of users who are members of a specific group identified by its ID.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Get List of Users from Group Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Groups_GetUsesFromGroup).

This endpoint removes one or more users from a specific group identified by its name.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Delete User(s) from Group Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Groups_DeleteUserFromGroup).

item.name: Add user(s) to the particular group

request.description:
This endpoint adds one or more users, identified by their IDs, to a specific group identified by its name.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Add User(s) to the Particular Group Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Groups_AddUserToGroup).

item.description: The "Groups" in the Bold Reports v5.0 Postman collection contains seven endpoints focused on managing groups within the Bold Reports Enterprise Edition. These endpoints enable developers to create, retrieve, update, delete, and manage user memberships for groups, facilitating efficient group-based access control and collaboration for reporting resources.

item.name: Settings

This endpoint updates general account settings, such as activation modes and default group configurations, for the Bold Reports instance.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Update Account Settings Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Settings_EditAccountsSettingsOfSite).

This endpoint retrieves the current IP whitelisting rules configured for the Bold Reports instance.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Get IP Whitelisting Settings Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Administartion_GetIPWhitelistingSettings).

This endpoint updates the IP whitelisting rules for the Bold Reports instance, enhancing security by restricting access to specified IP addresses.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Update IP Whitelisting Settings Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Administartion_UpdateIPWhitelistingSettings).

This endpoint generates a secret key for embedding reports in external applications, enabling secure integration.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Generate Embed Secret Key Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Settings_GenerateEmbedSecretKey).

This endpoint updates the branding settings for the Bold Reports instance, allowing customization of logos, themes, and other visual elements.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Update Branding Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/settings_update_branding).

This endpoint updates the email configuration settings for the Bold Reports instance, enabling customization of notification and report delivery options.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Update Email Settings Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Settings_EditEmailSettingsOfSite).

item.description: The "Settings" in the Bold Reports v5.0 Postman collection contains five endpoints focused on managing configuration settings for the Bold Reports Enterprise Edition. These endpoints enable developers to update account settings, manage IP whitelisting, generate embed secret keys, configure email settings, and customize branding, facilitating system customization and security.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Update Site Attribute Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Attributes_UpdateSiteAttributes).

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Delete Site Attributes Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Attributes_DeleteSiteAttributes).

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Update User Attribute Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Attributes_UpdateUserAttributes).

This endpoint deletes attributes for a specific user identified by their ID.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Delete User Attribute Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Attributes_DeleteUserAttributes).

This endpoint adds an attribute to a specific group identified by its ID.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Add Group Attribute Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Attributes_AddGroupAttributes).

This endpoint updates an existing attribute for a specific group identified by its ID.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Update Group Attribute Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Attributes_UpdateGroupAttributes).

This endpoint retrieves all attributes for a specific group identified by its ID.

For more details, refer to the [V5.0 - Get Group Attribute Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v5.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Attributes_GetGroupAttributes).
